MIAMI, Nov. 17, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Wrap Technologies, Inc. (NASDAQ: WRAP) (“WRAP” or the “Company”), a public safety technology company focused on non-lethal response solutions, today highlighted strategic alignment between its integrated capabilities and the U.S. Senate Appropriations Committee’s (the “Committee”) fiscal year 2027 Homeland Security appropriations explanatory statement1.

In the explanatory statement, the Committee encourages the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), including U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP), to expand access to non-lethal technologies and de-escalation training. It also addresses scenario-based decision-making, constitutionally sound use-of-force practices, safe transitions to physical custody, and evaluation of non-lethal compliance technologies when communication-based de-escalation is unsuccessful.
